chains.title: HMGA1 binding at a speculative distal element alters FAM110B
chains.element: Speculative unannotated distal element; no cCRE overlap (E01, E03)

links.claim: HMGA1 is predicted to bind the alt allele more strongly than ref in QBiC group G077 (AT hook, own model, z=29.74, effect=2.006; HMGA1 expression 238.96 TPM). The group is not uniformly directional because SETBP1 has the opposite sign, and E19 reports no HMGA1 ENCODE ChIP-seq peak containing the variant in HepG2, although absence can reflect no HMGA1 experiment in that biosample.

The variant could lie in an unannotated distal regulatory element, but E01 reports no regulatory features and E03 reports no cCRE overlap, with the nearest cCRE 1544 bp away. This element claim is speculative.

FAM110B is the nearest protein-coding gene at 420.6 kb, and E06 is a literature-search hit connecting FAM110B with LDL/statine response, but no quote or direct functional evidence is provided. E20 finds no significant liver eQTL, so the variant-to-FAM110B link is not supported by GTEx liver eQTL.
Hep3B2.1-7 expresses HMGA1 at high levels, supporting cell-type availability, but functional relevance of this architectural TF at this site is not demonstrated.

No direct evidence shows allele-dependent FAM110B expression or an LDL-cholesterol effect. E04 and E05 are null for genetic support, and E20 is negative for liver eQTL; the phenotype direction is not established.

predictions: HMGA1 occupancy is higher on the alt allele than ref at rs7001688 in a hepatocyte model.
FAM110B expression changes with the allele in a hepatocyte or liver model.
LDL cholesterol tracks the FAM110B expression change if the link is causal.
falsified_if: Allele-specific HMGA1 occupancy at rs7001688 is absent in a hepatocyte model.
FAM110B expression is unchanged by the allele in a hepatocyte or liver model.
No chromatin-contact or perturbation evidence links this element to FAM110B.

chains.title: RELA binding at a speculative distal element represses CYP7A1
chains.element: Speculative unannotated distal element; no cCRE overlap (E01, E03)

links.claim: RELA is predicted to bind the alt allele more strongly than ref in QBiC group G315 (Rel, own model, z=33.95, effect=1.34; RELA expression 73.44 TPM). This is in vitro SELEX evidence only; E18 reports no RELA ENCODE ChIP-seq peak containing the variant in HepG2, although absence can reflect no RELA experiment in that biosample.

The variant could lie in an unannotated distal regulatory element, but E01 reports no regulatory features and E03 reports no cCRE overlap, with the nearest cCRE 1544 bp away. The element claim is therefore speculative.

An altered RELA site could in principle regulate CYP7A1, a cholesterol/bile-acid gene 926.8 kb away, but E02 provides only genomic distance and E20 finds no significant liver eQTL. No contact or perturbation evidence connects this variant to CYP7A1.
Hep3B2.1-7 expresses RELA, making a hepatic RELA mechanism possible, but this does not establish hepatocyte-like LDL/cholesterol handling by this site.

No direct evidence links RELA binding at this variant to CYP7A1 expression, bile-acid synthesis, or LDL cholesterol. E04 and E05 are null for genetic support, and the direction of any LDL effect is not established.

predictions: RELA occupancy is higher on the alt allele than ref at rs7001688 in a hepatocyte model.
CYP7A1 expression is reduced when the alt allele is present, if RELA represses CYP7A1.
LDL cholesterol is higher with the alt allele if CYP7A1 repression is causal.
falsified_if: Allele-specific RELA occupancy at rs7001688 is absent in a hepatocyte model.
CYP7A1 expression or bile-acid output is unchanged by the allele in a hepatocyte model.
Genetic colocalization or perturbation shows no causal link between this locus and LDL cholesterol.

chains.title: TEAD1 binding at a speculative distal element activates CYP7A1
chains.element: Speculative unannotated distal element; no cCRE overlap (E01, E03)

links.claim: TEAD1 is predicted to bind the alt allele more strongly than ref in QBiC group G031 (TEA, own model, z=23.14, effect=1.505; TEAD1 expression 29.24 TPM), but TEAD2/TEAD3/TEAD4 also pass and TEAD-family redundancy weakens the specific TEAD1 claim.

The variant could lie in an unannotated distal regulatory element, but E01 reports no regulatory features and E03 reports no cCRE overlap, with the nearest cCRE 1544 bp away. The element claim is speculative.

An altered TEAD1 site could in principle act over long distance on CYP7A1, 926.8 kb away, but E02 provides only distance and E20 finds no significant liver eQTL. No contact or perturbation evidence supports this link.
Hep3B2.1-7 expresses TEAD1, making a hepatic TEAD mechanism possible, but this does not establish that this site mediates hepatic cholesterol handling.
No direct evidence connects TEAD1 binding at this locus to CYP7A1 expression or LDL cholesterol. E04 and E05 are null for genetic support, and the phenotype direction is not established.

predictions: TEAD1 occupancy is higher on the alt allele than ref at rs7001688.
CYP7A1 expression is increased when the alt allele is present, if TEAD1 activates CYP7A1.
LDL cholesterol is lower with the alt allele if CYP7A1 activation is causal.
falsified_if: Allele-specific TEAD1 occupancy at rs7001688 is absent.
CYP7A1 expression is unchanged by the allele in a hepatocyte model.
TEAD2/TEAD3/TEAD4, rather than TEAD1, account for any allelic binding effect at this site.

chains.title: ZNF580 loss of binding at a speculative distal element derepresses FAM110B
chains.element: Speculative unannotated distal element; no cCRE overlap (E01, E03)

links.claim: ZNF580 is predicted to bind the ref allele more strongly than alt in QBiC group G540 (C2H2 ZF, own model, z=-29.06, effect=-1.205; ZNF580 expression 8.54 TPM). This is in vitro SELEX evidence only and ZNF580 expression is low.

The variant could alter an unannotated distal regulatory element, but E01 reports no regulatory features and E03 reports no cCRE overlap, with the nearest cCRE 1544 bp away. The element claim is speculative.
Loss of a ZNF580 site could affect FAM110B, 420.6 kb upstream, but E02 gives only genomic distance; no direct ZNF580-FAM110B evidence or liver eQTL support is provided.
Hep3B2.1-7 expresses ZNF580 at low levels, making this a weaker cell-type rationale than for higher-expression candidates.

If ZNF580 normally represses a target gene, loss of ZNF580 binding on the alt allele could derepress the target and alter LDL cholesterol, but no evidence establishes this direction or the phenotype link.

predictions: ZNF580 occupancy is higher on the ref allele than alt at rs7001688.
The target gene is derepressed on the alt allele if ZNF580 represses it.
LDL cholesterol differs according to the target-gene direction.
falsified_if: ZNF580 occupancy is not higher on the ref allele.
FAM110B or another target gene is unchanged when the ZNF580 site is lost.
ZNF580 is not expressed or functional in the relevant hepatocyte context.

grades_v0.reason: RELA is shown as an own-model QBiC hit, but the chain uses in vitro SELEX binding as the only binding evidence. The element is unsupported by ENCODE/SCREEN, CYP7A1 is 926.8 kb away with no contact/perturbation evidence, and no genetic or phenotype evidence links this variant to LDL.
E01 reports no regulatory features and E03 reports no cCRE overlap; this is consistent with an unannotated element but does not demonstrate one.
E02 only gives genomic distance to CYP7A1; no chromatin interaction, eQTL, reporter, or perturbation evidence connects this variant/element to CYP7A1.
E08 supports RELA expression in ACH-000625, but the broader claim that this establishes hepatocyte-like LDL/cholesterol handling is not directly evidenced.
No cited evidence links RELA binding at this variant to CYP7A1 expression, bile-acid synthesis, or LDL cholesterol. E04 and E05 are null for genetic support.
HMGA1 has an own-model QBiC-SELEX hit favoring alt, but this is only an in vitro binding prediction; the group also contains an opposing member (SETBP1), so direction is not uniformly supported.
E01 and E03 show no annotated cCRE at the variant; absence of annotation is compatible with, but does not establish, an unannotated distal element.

FAM110B is merely the nearest coding gene at 420.6 kb, and E06 is a literature-search hit with no shown quote or direct evidence that this variant regulates FAM110B or that FAM110B mediates LDL effects.
E10 supports high HMGA1 expression in ACH-000625, but functional relevance as a chromatin-associated regulator in this cell type is not directly shown.
No cited evidence shows allele-dependent FAM110B expression or an LDL-cholesterol effect. E06 is at best an indirect literature association and does not establish the chain's phenotype direction.
TEAD1 has an own-model QBiC-SELEX hit favoring alt, but this remains a binding prediction; TEAD family redundancy and the lack of occupancy data weaken the specific TEAD1 claim.
E01 and E03 provide no cCRE overlap and no regulatory annotation; this does not support a TEAD1-bound distal element at the variant.
E02 only supplies distance to CYP7A1 (926.8 kb); there is no evidence for long-range TEAD1 regulation of CYP7A1.
E16 supports TEAD1 expression in ACH-000625, but not the broader hepatic cholesterol-handling rationale.
No cited evidence connects TEAD1 binding at this locus to CYP7A1 expression or LDL cholesterol; the direction is explicitly asserted as uncertain.
ZNF580 is the sole own-model member of QBiC group G540 and favors ref binding, but this is only an in vitro SELEX prediction and ZNF580 expression is low (8.54 TPM).
No cCRE overlaps the variant and no epigenomic evidence supports an unannotated ZNF580-responsive element at this site.
The gene link is only by proximity to FAM110B (420.6 kb); the chain itself notes no direct ZNF580-FAM110B evidence.
E11 supports low-level ZNF580 expression in ACH-000625, but the claim that this is too weak relative to other candidates is a comparative inference not directly tested here.
No cited evidence links ZNF580 loss at this variant to derepression of a target gene or to LDL cholesterol.
